notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 with new content!
notes.content:
3 Redesigned scenarios with a handful of new tutorials that smoothly introduce the player to the game.
A new feature that allows you to check the statistics of monsters in the current wave during a scenario
New Feature - When you upgrade a tower, it is also repaired


Game Balance:
All 4 difficulty levels have been lowered.
Increased gold and gem collection area


The first three scenarios have been completely redesigned and introduce the rules of the game seamlessly with new extensive tutorials.
1. First Scenario - basics of the game, including:
- Presentation of the mechanics of mines that extract gold
- Construction of turrets
- Various types of fields for development

2. Second Scenario:
- Introduction to the mechanics of special abilities - Meteor Shower, Pentagram, Frost Nova

3. Third scenario:
- Introducing two new types of towers: freezing and poisoning enemies.
- Introducing the mechanics of a monster sacrificing a soul - Monsters explode and destroy your turrets.
- Mechanics presentation with ruins

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.content: Skills: Meteor Shower, Pentagram and Frost Nova are now mapped with keys 1,2,3.
